instruction: Crisp studio photograph, full shot. In an indoor studio with draped beige curtains, a shirtless man in black pants (R2) stands with his back to the camera, lifting a woman in a beige sports bra and black shorts (R1) horizontally above his head. The shirtless man supports her upper back and thigh with his hands. The woman arches her back, extending her left arm upward. No bystanders are present. Soft, diffused studio lighting illuminates their athletic forms against the neutral background, creating a clean, focused composition.
